description: Painted brim ear compensation and matching-island consumer probes. Use fff_print_skirt_brim_tests with tests/controls/skirt_brim.json.

mutants.description: Skip projecting the painted ear center to the post-EFC outline while retaining EFC for the base brim. The enabled/disabled geometry relation and the compensated-outline radius witness should fail.

Select the nearest point from all compensated islands instead of restricting the projection to the raw island containing the painted point. In the two-island fixture, the adjacent island is geometrically closer but must not receive the ear.
